scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/prompts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/references build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/prompts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/references build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/prompts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/references build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
